design.fit_rule: fit and select ONLY on the source family within the same checkpoint basis
design.freeze_rule: freeze the head, then open the target family exactly once
design.name: 2x2 checkpoint x family factorial
design.rationale: The v5 export confounds family with checkpoint; the two 32-D bases are independent (rel-L2 1.41542 vs sqrt(2)=1.41421), so a head fitted in one basis cannot be applied in the other.  Here the SAME checkpoint encodes both source and target family, so transfer is measured inside one basis.
design.stage_rule: split 1 stages first at full scale (held-out 6bba ~ 85% of the objective)

feasibility.kernels_cannot_be_merged_because: the LOEO retarget binds one fold at module level and rebinds TEST_DIR globally, so a single kernel cannot serve both checkpoints
feasibility.verdict: does NOT fit: exceeds the entire remaining GPU budget

what_has_to_give.principle: TARGET cells are the measurement and stay at full scale; SOURCE cells only have to supply fitting rows for a 33-parameter pointwise head in a 32-D basis, so they can be cut to the stratified subsample
what_has_to_give.split_1_only_covers: the primary experiment: held-out 6bba, ~85% of the pooled objective

storage_model.derivation: feat_gt and feat_max are float32 (n_rows, 32) npy with n_rows = gt_nodes + T*(N_UNIFORM+N_SUBTHR) = gt_nodes + 9600; the rows.parquet residual fits 179_000 + 119*gt_nodes.  Reproduces all three measured v5 smoke crops to within 0.25%.
